descriptions.en:
Before you use this operation, make sure that you are familiar with the billing of PAI-DLC and the [pricing](~~171758~~).
><notice>The total length of CreateJob request parameters, including system-generated parameters, cannot exceed 65,536 bytes.></notice>.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun pai-dlc create-ray-history-server --display-name my-ray-history-server --storage-path oss://bucket-test-hangzhou.oss-cn-hangzhou-internal.aliyuncs.com/tmp --workspace-id 12345 --resource-id quotaxxx --ecs-spec ecs.c6.large --max-runtime-minutes 1000 --accessibility PRIVATE --region cn-hangzhou
